job_title: Team Head, Technology and Operational Risk Management (T&O COO Office)
industry: Banking & Financial Services - Technology & Operations Risk
role_summary: Senior risk leadership role converging Operational Risk Management and Technology Risk Management within the T&O COO Office of a major bank in Hong Kong. The role owns strategy, governance, and execution for enterprise operational and technology risk, including RCSA, KRI reporting, third-party/vendor risk, operational resilience, New Product Approval, and regulatory engagement with HKMA (TM-E-1, TM-G-1, SA-2, C-RAF). The Team Head leads and develops risk teams, champions risk culture across T&O, and advises senior stakeholders on emerging technology risks such as Generative AI and Public Cloud.
must_have_requirements: Senior leadership experience in risk management within financial services/banking, overseeing both operational and technology risk functions
Proven track record leading and developing risk teams and influencing senior stakeholders in a complex organization
Hands-on expertise in operational risk and technology risk frameworks (RCSA, KRI development, incident management) at a large financial institution
Deep knowledge of operational processes, controls, and technology infrastructure in banking
Extensive regulatory engagement experience, particularly with HKMA requirements (TM-E-1, TM-G-1, SA-2, C-RAF) or equivalent regulators
Experience managing third-party/vendor risk and ensuring resilience of critical business services
Experience overseeing New Product Approval or similar new-product risk assessment processes
Strong understanding of information security, system resiliency/availability, and software development practices
Knowledge of emerging technology risks - Generative AI and Public Cloud
Degree in Risk Management, Information Systems, Finance, Business Administration, or related field
nice_to_have_requirements: Professional certifications: CISA, CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ECF-ORM
Experience with Site Reliability Engineering risk domains
Experience leading risk governance forums/committees at regional or group level
Familiarity with operational resilience frameworks encompassing critical business services
Experience liaising with internal/external auditors, legal, compliance, and regulators
Exposure to data analytics-driven risk control frameworks
soft_skills_priority: Stakeholder influence and senior executive communication
Risk culture championing and change leadership
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

scoring_criteria.name: Senior Risk Leadership Experience (Banking/FSI)
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role requires a proven senior leader capable of setting strategy and representing the unit at executive/regulatory forums
evidence_type_to_look_for: Head of Risk / Director / VP titles
experience presenting to risk committees or regulators
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: May lack exact 'Team Head' title but equivalent scope acceptable

scoring_criteria.name: Operational Risk Management Expertise (RCSA/KRI)
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Core deliverable is oversight of RCSA and KRI programmes across the unit

scoring_criteria.name: Technology Risk Management Expertise
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role converges ORM and TRM, requiring technical risk knowledge across infrastructure, security, and resilience

scoring_criteria.name: Regulatory Engagement (HKMA or equivalent)
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Extensive regulatory dialogue is explicitly required, especially HKMA technology/operational risk guidelines
evidence_type_to_look_for: familiarity with TM-E-1/TM-G-1/SA-2/C-RAF or similar frameworks (e.g., MAS, FCA)
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates from non-HK markets may show equivalent regulator experience instead of HKMA specifically

scoring_criteria.name: Third-Party/Vendor Risk & Operational Resilience
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Explicit responsibility for third-party risk and critical business service resilience

scoring_criteria.name: Emerging Technology Risk (GenAI, Cloud)
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role explicitly covers Generative AI and Public Cloud risk oversight, a differentiator for modern TRM leaders
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Many senior risk leaders may have limited hands-on GenAI experience; assess via adjacent cloud/tech risk exposure

scoring_criteria.name: New Product Approval / Product Risk Governance
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role directly oversees NPA team ensuring rigorous risk assessment for new offerings

scoring_criteria.name: Team Leadership & Risk Culture Building
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role requires inspiring and developing teams while embedding a proactive risk culture across the organization

scoring_criteria.name: Stakeholder Management & Executive Communication
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Must influence senior leaders across Technology, Operations, and Business Units, and represent unit externally

scoring_criteria.name: Certifications & Education Fit
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Relevant degree and certifications (CISA, CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ECF-ORM) support technical credibility though not strictly mandatory
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Certification absence is common and should not heavily penalize otherwise strong candidates

summary_focus: Position candidate as a senior risk leader bridging operational and technology risk in banking/FSI
Highlight scale of teams led, regulatory bodies engaged, and frameworks implemented (RCSA, KRI, TPRM)
Emphasize exposure to emerging tech risk (cloud, AI) and resilience/third-party risk programs
Quantify impact: risk reduction, audit findings closed, incidents mitigated, regulatory submissions delivered
do_not_overclaim: Do not claim direct HKMA regulatory relationship if experience is with a different regulator - state the actual regulator
Do not overstate hands-on Generative AI risk expertise if experience is limited to general cloud/tech risk - clarify scope
Do not claim ownership of New Product Approval process unless directly responsible - specify contributing vs owning role
Avoid implying larger team size or budget than actually managed

cover_letter_guidance.tone: Executive, authoritative, and risk-culture-driven, reflecting gravitas expected of a senior banking risk leader
cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Position candidate as a strategic convergence leader who can unify operational and technology risk disciplines, drive regulatory confidence, and modernize risk frameworks for emerging tech (AI, cloud) within a complex banking environment
bridge_gaps_honestly: If lacking direct HKMA experience, highlight equivalent regulatory engagement (e.g., MAS, FCA, OCC) and transferable regulatory acumen
If GenAI/cloud risk exposure is limited, emphasize broader technology risk governance and willingness/capability to rapidly upskill in emerging tech domains
If New Product Approval ownership is partial, clarify collaborative role and risk assessment contributions rather than full ownership
